questions.q: What made Quraysh realise the Kaaba had to be rebuilt?
options: A great flood and a theft
questions.explain: A great flood and a theft made Quraysh realise the Kaaba needed to be rebuilt.

questions.q: Money from which sources did Quraysh accept for building the Kaaba?
options: Any source as long as it was a lot
questions.explain: Quraysh accepted money only from clean sources, not from wine, theft or fraud.

questions.q: Who bravely began pulling the Kaaba down with an axe?
questions.explain: Al-Walid prayed not to be punished since they were repairing Allah's house.

questions.q: Who was the Roman architect who redesigned the Kaaba?
questions.explain: Bakum changed the design into a rectangle with a roof and a raised door.

questions.q: For how many days did construction stop because the tribes quarrelled over the Black Stone?
questions.explain: The project stopped for five days because the tribes quarrelled.

questions.q: What was Abu Umayyah's proposal to settle the dispute?
options: Fight until there is a winner
The first person to enter the gate tomorrow morning decides
questions.explain: The first to enter the gate the next morning would decide, and that was Muhammad.

questions.q: How did the Prophet SAW settle the dispute over the Black Stone?
options: He placed it himself while the other tribes waited
He placed the stone on a cloth and every tribe held it
He gave it to the oldest tribe
questions.explain: Every tribe held the cloth and the Prophet SAW placed the stone. All got an equal share.

questions.q: All the tribes accepted Muhammad as judge because he was called Al-Amin.
questions.explain: True. Al-Amin means the trustworthy, his title before prophethood.

questions.q: Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail worshipped idols like the other people of Makkah.
questions.explain: False. Zaid rejected idols and said they were not following Prophet Ibrahim's religion.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: The Prophet SAW sets the Black Stone on a cloth
The tribes quarrel over the Black Stone

questions.explain: The flood, Al-Walid's demolition, the quarrel, Abu Umayyah's proposal, and then the Prophet SAW placing the stone on the cloth.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The bordered area beside the Kaaba

questions.explain: Hijr Ismail is the area beside the Kaaba, Al-Amin means trustworthy, tawaf is circling the Kaaba, and jahiliyyah is the era before Islam.

questions.q: You want others to trust you. What can you learn from Al-Amin?
questions.explain: All the tribes accepted him as judge because he was the most honest.
